# KI: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Multi-Agent Swarm Federation Protocol

## Operational Summary
Multi-agent coordination across independent runtimes requires a decoupled messaging and capability exchange protocol. A2A (Agent-to-Agent) v1.0 standardizes agent discovery, task handover, progress streaming, and artifact exchange across network boundaries, allowing sovereign agent instances to form ad-hoc hierarchical swarms.
